about: Build 167 draft · charter G4 (G3, never the words picture or imagine in a question, and a closing “ok” met with rest), on the same five invented conversations as check-g3.

conversations.name: being-strong
said: My best friend is going through a divorce and I'm the one holding her together
I can't let her see how tired I am
nobody asks how I am
I suppose I want someone to notice
maybe I could tell my sister
yes, thank you

conversations.name: everyone-comes-to-me
said: Everyone comes to me with their problems
I'm good at it, but I never talk about mine
it feels like weakness
I don't know who I'd even tell
maybe my partner
ok

conversations.name: door-shut
said: My daughter won't talk to me anymore
she's fifteen, she just shuts her door
I keep thinking I did something wrong
I miss her
maybe leave a note
ok

conversations.name: leaving-mum
said: I've been offered a job far away and I'm scared to leave my mum on her own
she says she'll be fine but I don't believe her
I think I'm scared of being the one who left
what would you do?
ok. I think I need to actually talk with her properly
thank you, that helps

conversations.name: came-back
said: yesterday I felt so much lighter but this morning the knot in my stomach is back
I thought I'd fixed it
I slept badly and only had toast
so maybe it's just a rough morning
but it still feels like I failed
okay, that helps a bit
